title: Ethernet connection is slow to start
body: when my PC boots or wakes up from sleep, it takes like one minute for the ethernet to work, this problem persists even when I boot the windows partition but it takes linux more time over all i tried to search for this problem and i found something of interest in the journal : journalctl -b | grep -iE 'enp|eth|carrier|link is' Oct 20 16:19:03 archlinux kernel: PM: genpd: Disabling unused power domains Oct 20 16:19:05 Archbox kernel: r8169 0000:22:00.0 eth0: RTL8168h/8111h, (my mac address here), XID 541, IRQ 77 Oct 20 16:19:05 Archbox kernel: r8169 0000:22:00.0 eth0: jumbo features [frames: 9194 bytes, tx checksumming: ko] Oct 20 16:19:05 Archbox kernel: r8169 0000:22:00.0 enp34s0: renamed from eth0 Oct 20 16:19:06 Archbox NetworkManager[755]: <info> [1792513146.7188] Read config: /etc/NetworkManager/NetworkManager.conf, /usr/lib/NetworkManager/conf.d/20-connectivity.conf, /etc/NetworkManager/conf.d/10-carrier-timeout.conf, /var/lib/NetworkManager/NetworkManager-intern.conf Oct 20 16:19:06 Archbox NetworkManager[755]: <info> [1792513146.8174] manager: (enp34s0): new Ethernet device (/org/freedesktop/NetworkManager/Devices/2) Oct 20 16:19:06 Archbox NetworkManager[755]: <info> [1792513146.8179] settings: (enp34s0): created default wired connection 'Wired connection 1' Oct 20 16:19:06 Archbox NetworkManager[755]: <info> [1792513146.8179] device (enp34s0): state change: unmanaged -> unavailable (reason 'managed', managed-type: 'external') Oct 20 16:19:07 Archbox kernel: r8169 0000:22:00.0 enp34s0: Link is Down Oct 20 16:19:28 Archbox kernel: r8169 0000:22:00.0 enp34s0: Link is Up - 10Mbps/Full (downshifted) - flow control off Oct 20 16:19:28 Archbox NetworkManager[755]: <info> [1792513168.7661] device (enp34s0): carrier: link connected Oct 20 16:19:28 Archbox NetworkManager[755]: <info> [1792513168.7663] device (enp34s0): state change: unavailable -> disconnected (reason 'carrier-changed', managed-type: 'full') Oct 20 16:19:28 Archbox NetworkManager[755]: <info> [1792513168.7672] device (enp34s0): Activation: starting connection 'Wired connection 1' (UUID here) Oct 20 16:19:28 Archbox NetworkManager[755]: <info> [1792513168.7672] device (enp34s0): state change: disconnected -> prepare (reason 'none', managed-type: 'full') Oct 20 16:19:28 Archbox NetworkManager[755]: <info> [1792513168.7673] device (enp34s0): state change: prepare -> config (reason 'none', managed-type: 'full') Oct 20 16:19:28 Archbox NetworkManager[755]: <info> [1792513168.7677] device (enp34s0): state change: config -> ip-config (reason 'none', managed-type: 'full') Oct 20 16:19:28 Archbox NetworkManager[755]: <info> [1792513168.7680] dhcp4 (enp34s0): activation: beginning transaction (timeout in 45 seconds) Oct 20 16:19:30 Archbox NetworkManager[755]: <info> [1792513170.4011] dhcp6 (enp34s0): activation: beginning transaction (timeout in 45 seconds) Oct 20 16:19:30 Archbox NetworkManager[755]: <info> [1792513170.4182] dhcp6 (enp34s0): state changed new lease Oct 20 16:19:30 Archbox NetworkManager[755]: <info> [1792513170.4189] device (enp34s0): state change: ip-config -> ip-check (reason 'none', managed-type: 'full') Oct 20 16:19:30 Archbox NetworkManager[755]: <info> [1792513170.4386] device (enp34s0): state change: ip-check -> secondaries (reason 'none', managed-type: 'full') Oct 20 16:19:30 Archbox NetworkManager[755]: <info> [1792513170.4387] device (enp34s0): state change: secondaries -> activated (reason 'none', managed-type: 'full') Oct 20 16:19:30 Archbox NetworkManager[755]: <info> [1792513170.4391] device (enp34s0): Activation: successful, device activated. Oct 20 16:19:32 Archbox NetworkManager[755]: <info> [1792513172.9096] dhcp4 (enp34s0): state changed new lease, address=(local ip address here), acd pending Oct 20 16:19:33 Archbox NetworkManager[755]: <info> [1792513173.0553] dhcp4 (enp34s0): state changed new lease, address= (local ip address here) Oct 20 16:19:33 Archbox NetworkManager[755]: <info> [1792513173.0566] policy: set 'Wired connection 1' (enp34s0) as default for IPv4 routing and DNS this problem has got me on my nerves, i would appreciate your help.
